units.source_text: 薰大将最后退出。

en.t: General Kaoru was the last to withdraw.

units.source_text: 他想起出门时那个随从的态度，觉得有些奇怪。

en.t: He recalled the attitude of that attendant as he was leaving and found it rather strange.

units.source_text: 便趁前驱人等走到庭前去点灯的时候，召唤这随从过来，问道：“刚才你说的是什么事情？”

en.t: So, while the outriders and others went out to the garden to light the lamps, he called the attendant over and asked, "What was it you mentioned just now?"

units.source_text: 随从答道：“今天早上小人在宇治山庄里，

en.t: The attendant replied, "This morning, while I was at the Uji villa,

units.source_text: 看见出云权守时方朝臣家的一个男仆，

en.t: I saw a manservant from the household of Tokikata, Acting Governor of Izumo,

units.source_text: 拿着一封结在樱花枝上的紫色薄纸信件，

en.t: holding a letter on purple thin paper tied to a branch of cherry blossoms,

units.source_text: 从西面的边门里交给一个侍女。

en.t: and handing it through the western side gate to a lady's maid.

units.source_text: 小人向这男仆如此如此地探问，

en.t: I questioned the manservant about this and that,

units.source_text: 他的回答先后不符，似是说谎。

en.t: but his answers contradicted one another, and he seemed to be lying.

units.source_text: 小人怪他为何言语如此，特派一个童子跟着他走，

en.t: Finding his words suspicious, I sent a boy to follow him,

units.source_text: 童子看见他走到兵部卿亲王府上，

en.t: and the boy saw him go to the residence of the Prince Minister of War,

units.source_text: 把回信交给了式部少辅道定朝臣。”

en.t: where he handed the reply to Michisada, Assistant Secretary of the Ministry of Ceremonial."

units.source_text: 薰大将觉得奇怪，又问：“山庄里送出来的回信是什么样子的？”

en.t: General Kaoru found this strange and asked again, "What did the reply sent from the villa look like?"

units.source_text: 随从答道：“这个小人不曾看见，因为是从另一扇门里送出来的。

en.t: The attendant answered, "I did not see that myself, because it was sent out through another gate.

units.source_text: 但据童子说，是红色的，非常漂亮。”

en.t: But according to the boy, it was red and very beautiful."

units.source_text: 薰大将想起刚才看到匂亲王手里的信，觉得一点也不错。

en.t: General Kaoru remembered the letter he had just seen in Prince Niou's hand and felt there could be no mistake.

units.source_text: 这随从能够如此侦察，实甚能干。

en.t: For this attendant to have investigated so thoroughly showed that he was truly capable.

units.source_text: 但因近旁人多，他也不再细问。

en.t: But since many people were nearby, he did not question him any further.

units.source_text: 在归途中想道：“这位亲王连角落里都找到，实在令人吃惊！

en.t: On the way back, he thought, "This prince even manages to search out hidden corners; it is truly astonishing!

units.source_text: 不知道他因什么机会而知道有这个人的。

en.t: I wonder through what chance he learned that this person existed.

units.source_text: 又不知道是怎样地爱上她的。

en.t: And I wonder how he came to fall in love with her.
